question: Does debrid/fast-down give a non-premium account a free download or storage quota, and of what size? The verdict is paid-only, but no page read (homepage, FAQ, premium, terms, register) says the service requires payment.
why: The homepage offers an upload form (10240 Mb per file) beside Login and Sign Up, and the premium page sells No Waiting & No Captcha as premium additions, which implies a free path. The free quota is unverified: behind a sign-up. The verdict vocabulary has no unverified term, so the verdict stays paid-only until an account page shows the free quota.
